name: chesscom-clone
description: A chess.com-like multiplayer chess platform (Next.js + Node + Socket.io + Prisma)

scripts.build: npm -w @chess/server run build && npm -w @chess/web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm -w @chess/server run start" "npm -w @chess/web run start"
